models.name: Dia2 2B
models.identity_note: Original Nari Labs 2B streaming dialogue model, distinct from Dia 1.6B and Dia2 1B. Exact model size and repository corroborate Singh et al. arXiv:2601.20510v1 section 3.1 and reference 19. Official card has a multi-step uv/CUDA setup; no tested one-command install or RAM guarantee supplied.

models.name: Glow-TTS + HiFi-GAN (Grad-TTS study)
models.identity_note: Official Glow-TTS implementation acoustic model paired with HiFi-GAN by the Grad-TTS authors in ICML 2021 section 4 / Table 2. Study-specific evaluated system; exact trained weights are not verified as released, so no open-weight or run-availability claim. Distinct from Coqui Glow-TTS and NVIDIA Tacotron2 + WaveGlow.
